name: TinkerBlink Library
description: Arduino/C++ library for self-hosted Blynk Legacy servers (blynk-server 0.41.x and the 0.50.x fork). Maintained continuation of the Blynk library 0.6.1 for ESP8266, ESP32, Arduino and more, over WiFi, Ethernet, GSM, BLE, Bluetooth and Serial. Companion of the TinkerBlink app. Not affiliated with Blynk Inc.
keywords: blynk, blynk-legacy, tinkerblink, iot, control, device, smartphone, app, protocol, wifi, ethernet, gsm, ble, bluetooth, serial, esp8266, esp32
